---
name: link-audit
description: Audit Ventura Toolkit design-system and UI reference links for canonical destinations duplicates and stale material. Use when maintaining or releasing the UI principles collection. Do not use when evaluating the design quality of a pattern itself.
---

# Link audit

- Check links in changed toolkit sections.
- Prefer canonical design-system documentation standards or original publishers.
- Detect duplicate destinations and redundant references.
- Flag dead moved or clearly obsolete resources.
- Preserve historical design references only when their role is explicit.
- Recheck Markdown formatting after edits.
